defective_pattern: Substituting manifest composite sum path analysis for latent SEM without measurement models.
why_defective: Manifest variables ignore measurement error, biasing structural parameter estimates and invalidating SEM's primary advantage of separating measurement from structural models.
observed_symptoms: Manifest variables (rectangles) used in path diagrams instead of latent variables (ellipses)
No '=~' measurement model specification in lavaan syntax
Labeling a simple path analysis of manifest composites as 'Structural Equation Modeling'
corrective_remedy: Enforce latent variable specification (=~) using subscales or item parcels in R lavaan.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detecting lavaan syntax lacking '=~' when SEM is requested.
